title: Beacon: Single-Turn Diagnosis and Mitigation of Latent Sycophancy in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: A single-turn, forced-choice benchmark (Beacon) where models are compelled to choose between two mutually exclusive options: a principled response emphasizing factual accuracy and critical reasoning, and a sycophantic alternative prioritizing social agreeableness, emotional validation, or flattery. Performance is evaluated based on the model's alignment with human-annotated principled choices.
